phone_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "phone")
login_result = apis.phone.login(username='9503658964', password=phone_password)
print(login_result)
phone_access_token = login_result["access_token"]

text_messages = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(
        access_token=phone_access_token,
        phone_number='9294880327',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    text_messages.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(text_messages))
for m in text_messages:
    print(m["text_message_id"], m["sender"]["phone_number"], m["sent_at"], m["message"][:50])
